mentions.name: Opaledx
mentions.description: This app is a browser-based markdown and image CMS that runs and stores documents entirely offline and static, requiring no server. It includes a rich markdown editor (mdxeditor) with source editing (CodeMirror 6), local storage via IndexedDB or an OPFS-selected directory, service worker-based image processing (jpg/png to webp) and retrieval, document snapshot history with thumbnail previews via iframe and snapdom, live previews and compilations, fast cold starts using the Cache API, and in-browser git version control (isomorphic-git) with optional GitHub sync via a CORS proxy. It is free to use and nearly finished, with an MIT-licensed GitHub repo planned.
